# IRAN

> A premium streaming home for original Iranian short films. Ticket-based, bilingual (English & Persian), no subscription — pay once per film and watch within 48 hours.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of IRAN, featured films, and how it works.
- [Browse](/browse): Full catalog of original Iranian short films, filterable by category.
- [About](/about): Mission, team, and the story behind IRAN.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch for questions, partnerships, or feedback.
